verdict.rationale: AMD publishes 288GB HBM3E and 8TB/s of bandwidth for the MI355X, plus MXFP4/MXFP6 low-precision datatype support. An independent architecture review confirms the same 288GB at 8TB/s and notes it helps where competing GPUs run out of VRAM, which comfortably covers a quantized 70B model on one GPU or node. AMD's docs also provide vLLM and SGLang inference recipes. missing for 10: a hands-on benchmark of a 70B-class quantized model on a single MI355X (the only community benchmark covers a much larger model on 8 GPUs)
